title: Library
lead: The movies and series in your media library, as its last sync found them: each with its versions, its files and the path this app reaches them at.

search.placeholder: Title, year, IMDb, TMDb or TVDB id, or path

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: The media libraries this list is read from, and the media folders, scanned for the files no library reported. A sync reads a whole library again and replaces what was stored from it; a scan only lists the files' names. Nothing changes in the libraries or the folders themselves.
